text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Winning Ticket has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Maaan, isn't there anything fun to do?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We've made it past the big rush of the
Twinkle
Series, so I wanna go somewhere
fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still remember her joy when she pulled
the grand
prize in the New Year's raffle.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, we promised t...
Come to think of it, we promised t...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeeaaah! Hot spring, hot spring, hot

SPRIIING!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
How could I forget about it? That was a
HUGE
promise we made!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sniffle! I'm so sorry, Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I can't stay calm now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
While we're just standing here, the hot
springs are
waiting for us!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaagh! Hang on just a little longer, hot
spring!
We'll be right there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After hurriedly gathering my things, I
head out to
the hot spring with Winning
Ticket.
choice_data_list: A-At least let me get ready...!
A-At least let me get ready...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! A real-life traditional inn.
This is

authentic stuff!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aww, look at us, how far we've finally come... Sniff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as we arrive, Winning Ticket
starts sobbing. Once I manage to calm
her down, we
make our way to the hot
spring.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaiit a minute!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Are you kidding, Trainer? There's one thing we gotta do before bathing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! When you think of stuff to do at a
hot
spring inn—it's gotta be table tennis!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Here I go! One Tickezo all-out explosive
smash,
COMING UP!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So Winning Ticket and I work up a
healthy sweat
over an intense table
tennis match.
choice_data_list: (The ball's flying off in a wild d...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay! This hot spring is the BEST!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bring some drinks to try to calm her
down, but...
choice_data_list: Alright, alright, just keep it dow...
Alright, alright, just keep it dow...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-is that... the legendary post-bath
coffee milk?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOHOOO! I'm gonna drink it in one
biiig gulp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, my efforts just seem to make
her even
more excited.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yum! That really hit the spot after a
good soak!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Table tennis, the hot spring, the
coffee
milk... This is all I've ever wanted!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's right!
choice_data_list: There's still a feast waiting for you.
There's still a feast waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A bounty of the seas and the mountains!
We got
the complete set!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I'm so glad... I've worked so hard up to now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our luxurious dinner, Ticket stops
by my
room.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wow, I'm so full!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The food was sooo good—I lost track of
how
many bowls I ate!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: I'm glad we could come here.
I'm glad we could come here.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know, just like how I'll never forget
about the
Twinkle Series, I'll never
forget about today
either!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I went full blast both in those
races and in
enjoying the hot springs
today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhhh! Everything was sooo fun!
I'll... I'll
always remember this daaay!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aww, Trainer! You took the words right
outta my
mouth!
choice_data_list: Let's win the race and make even m...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right! We're not done
yet—let's keep
the challenges coming!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run more exciting races! And
then we can
come to the hot springs
again!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeaaaah! I'm with you all the way,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: One, two, GOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Winning Ticket and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
